latest_events.title: Mali: Junta forces retake strategic town of Kidal
latest_events.summary: Mali's army, supported by Russian paramilitary forces, has re-entered the northern town of Kidal, forcing the Tuareg separatists to withdraw from the strategic hold, in a symbolic boost for the country's military government and its Russian allies. latest_events.summary: JNIM, a jihadist group linked to Al-Qaeda, claimed responsibility for an ambush on 28 September 2026 against a convoy of the Malian army and the Russian Africa Corps, near Niono, in central Mali. This is clearly an evolution that the armies of the Confederation of Sahel States (AES), which brings together Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger, have not been able to stop: in three years, armed groups in the region have gone from simple reconnaissance drones to strike weapons.
